positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: GraphQL · Java · gRPC · Elasticsearch · Kafka · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · CDC · Change Data Capture · Amazon Aurora · Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) · SQS · Conductor · Kotlin

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Part of of Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) organization. Created a new backend service to search log files using AWS. The service was composed of a state machine that could invoke 3,000+ Lambdas in parallel for efficient log searching. The service used AWS API Gateway and AWS Amplify to create a frontend webpage for easy log searching.
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Lambda · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · Java · AWS Step Functions · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed an interactive, modular metrics dashboard using Django and SQL. The dashboard allowed users to view realtime metrics on chip development progress.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · SQL · Django · SQLite · Python (Programming Language) · Reliability

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Contributed to the Enterprise Networking department working on Cisco's DNA Center. Utilized the Pytest framework in Python to validate API contracts.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Researching and designing low-cost user-friendly biosensors for detecting pathogens associated with bovine respiratory diseases. Building a device for processing samples and extracting DNA. Building a device for detecting colorimetric/fluorometric output from the biosensor.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for ECE 20007 – Electrical Engineering Fundamentals I Lab. Assist students with circuit construction, simulation, modeling and design.

positions.title: Bayer Crop Sciences Cooperate Partnership
positions.description: Utilizing data science tools to improve genomic prediction techniques. Evaluating various machine learning techniques to improve plant breeding, improving global food security and sustainability.

positions.title: Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description: Organized and led recreational activities for campers aged 3 to 12. Automated name tag system using Excel and Word. Acted as interim camp directer as needed. Awarded "Best New Staff Member".
